relations.subject: search:export-search-index
relations.evidence: Your user account has the [Search Admin](../learn/security/roles.md#search-admin) role for the bucket where you want to export an index definition.

relations.subject: search:export-search-index
relations.evidence: You cannot export a Search index definition as a downloadable file. You can only copy the Search index definition from an existing index.

relations.subject: search:export-search-index
relations.evidence: Use the Couchbase Server Web Console to copy and paste a JSON Search index definition for use in the REST API or another cluster.

relations.subject: search:export-search-index
relations.evidence: When you [create a Search index with the Server Web Console](create-search-index-ui.md), you can also click **copy to clipboard** on the **Index Definition Preview** to copy the Search index definition.

relations.subject: search:export-search-index
relations.evidence: You can paste the copied definition into a new `.json` file to import it into a new cluster, or use the definition with the [Search REST API](create-search-index-rest-api.md).

relations.subject: search:export-search-index
relations.evidence: To import your Search index definition into a new Couchbase Server cluster through the Web Console, see [Import a Search Index Definition with the Web Console](import-search-index.md).

notable_absence.finding: The Prerequisites gate the Search Admin role on exporting 'an index definition' specifically. This page never states whether copying an INDEX ALIAS's definition (as opposed to a plain index's) works the same way in the Web Console, or requires the same role - the Procedure's 'Show index definition JSON' / 'Copy to Clipboard' steps are described only in terms of a Search index, with no alias-specific mention, even though the paired import-search-index.md explicitly handles both an index AND an alias definition. If exporting an alias's definition works identically, the page never says so; if it does not work at all, that is an undocumented gap given that import supports it.

cross_component_finding: This page and the paired import-search-index.md (both in this batch) form a matched export/import pair sharing one real mechanism - the portable JSON Search index definition, minted here as search:search-index-definition-json - but the two pages are asymmetric in scope: export's Procedure and role requirement are written only in terms of a plain Search index, while import's Procedure explicitly branches into two menu actions, **Add Index** and **+ Add Alias**, for the two artifact kinds. So a reader can IMPORT an alias definition through this Web Console flow but the corpus (as documented on this export page) never confirms they can EXPORT one the same way. The 'JSON payload' language used generically elsewhere in this namespace (e.g. cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json's 'All Search indexes are built from a JSON payload') is the same underlying artifact this page calls a 'Search index definition' and calls it copyable 'for use in the REST API or another cluster' - three different pages, three slightly different names (JSON payload / Search index definition / JSON Search index definition) for what is functionally one thing.
